outcomeDiagnostic.interpretation: The aggregate No-selection decision contains a company-level recall miss candidate because one frozen constituent materially outperformed at every audited horizon. Outcome alone is not sufficient to modify the frozen decision.

claims: 1-9M attributable profit RMB1.540bn, +232.56% YoY; ex-item profit +238.66%.
1-9M operating cash flow RMB1.574bn, +78.98% YoY, showing earnings were substantially cash-backed.
Company attributed the profit increase to rising steel prices plus refined/lean management and improved profitability.
Cash was about RMB1.976bn and short-term borrowings about RMB2.039bn at Sep-30; long-term borrowings were zero in the consolidated balance sheet.
The controlling shareholder had 482m shares pledged out of 525.4m shares held, so pledge/governance risk was visible and should have been adversarially reviewed.
Contemporaneous research described Fangda as a regional long-products leader and niche special-steel oligopolist with strong product pricing power.
It explicitly argued the company was not constrained by the northern heating-season production cuts and would benefit from the resulting market conditions.
It cited improving leverage/cost control and forecast roughly 11x/10x/9x PE for 2017-2019, indicating the company-specific thesis was not dependent on an extreme valuation.
H1 revenue RMB6.272bn, +65.37% YoY; attributable profit RMB704.6m, +172.18%.
Company reported stable production, cost reduction through operational coordination and continued environmental/safety investment.
Automotive leaf-spring output rose 36.5%, providing product-mix exposure beyond generic construction steel.
cutoffValidEvidence.note: Exact publication day is not reasserted here; the H1 filing was publicly available well before the 2017-12-31 cutoff.

claims: Fangda was located in Nanchang and had full-process steel operations with about 3.6m tonnes capacity.
The company reported more than RMB2bn of cumulative technical/environmental upgrade investment since 2010.

It was among MIIT's first batch of companies meeting Steel Industry Standard Conditions and the first such Jiangxi steel company, providing a pre-cutoff reason to investigate compliance/geographic resilience rather than treating all steel producers alike.
cutoffValidEvidence.caveat: First-party/group source; should be corroborated rather than treated as sufficient on its own.

claims: By Dec-8, total pledged shares were reported at about 28.85% of total shares, so ownership/pledge risk was visible.
Pre-cutoff safety/environmental administrative penalties existed, including a Sep-2017 fatal-work-accident safety penalty and environmental penalties involving the company/subsidiaries.
These adverse facts argue for Research/adversarial review, not hindsight promotion to automatic Primary.

causalDiagnosis.originalReasonForNoSelection: Winter curtailment reduced supply but construction restrictions also reduced demand; no company-specific allowed-capacity/product-mix edge was frozen.
causalDiagnosis.newlyConfirmedProcessFailure: The research process stopped too early at the aggregate conflict. It did not systematically search for company exceptions with geography outside the constrained region, environmental/compliance resilience, differentiated product mix, strong realized earnings/cash conversion and acceptable valuation.
causalDiagnosis.whyThisIsNotAHindsightBuyRule: Fangda also had visible pledge, safety and environmental risks. Pre-cutoff evidence supports at least a company-level Research candidate, not an automatic Primary signal.

candidateGeneralizationForFutureValidati.name: company_exception_search_after_aggregate_conflict
candidateGeneralizationForFutureValidati.ruleIntent: Before final No selection on a mixed/conflicted industry state, test whether heterogeneity in geography, compliance, product mix, cost curve, contract structure or capacity allowance creates a listed-company exception with a different earnings path.
candidateGeneralizationForFutureValidati.oneWayProperty: The search can surface Research/company-mapping candidates but cannot waive existing timing, valuation, downside, adversarial-risk or earnings-conversion gates.
antiOverfit: Do not create a Fangda-specific, steel-specific, southern-mill or environmental-exemption rule.
Do not assume a company outside the regulated region is a winner without earnings and valuation evidence.
Do not promote a company merely because its peer basket later outperformed.
Do not use 2018 returns to decide which 2017 evidence should count.
Validate the capability on a different untouched window before changing the production Skill.
